teams.heading: Fiji face France in Round Four after previous away friendly defeat
teams.body: Fiji prepare to face France in Round Four of the tournament, looking to improve on their last meeting in November 2025. In that international friendly, Fiji suffered a 34-21 away defeat. The national side enters the upcoming fixture sitting 12th in the table after a 17-33 loss to Scotland in Round Three. Fiji have yet to secure a victory in the competition, registering three consecutive defeats whilst scoring 49 points and conceding 145.

teams.heading: England-born Georgie Perris-Redding leads United States into weekend Test match
teams.body: Former Sale flanker Georgie Perris-Redding is set to captain the US Eagles at Cardiff Arms Park this weekend. Born in Detroit but having developed her game at Crewe & Nantwich, the 29-year-old reflects on a career path that took her from the Premiership to the international stage. Now a full-time professional and a two-time World Cup participant, Perris-Redding admits her time at the American Rugby Professional Training Center was the first moment she realised, "I want more from my rugby."

teams.body: France have displayed notable attacking potency in their recent outings, scoring 426 points throughout their last 11 international matches. This run has seen them average 38.7 points per game, while conceding an average of 26.5 points during the same period. The side’s most significant offensive performance in this window was a 54-12 victory over Wales in February 2026, a result that highlights their capacity for high-scoring displays when performing at their peak.

teams.heading: Irish provinces launch 2026-27 campaign eyeing Rugby World Cup squad spots
teams.body: The United Rugby Championship returns this weekend, marking a pivotal period for players aiming to impress Ireland head coach Andy Farrell ahead of the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia. As Leinster begin their defence under outgoing head coach Leo Cullen, internal competition for international selection intensifies across all four provinces. Coaches have reshaped squads over the summer, with Connacht recruiting Ciaran Frawley and Ulster integrating new arrivals, all while balancing domestic ambitions against the looming requirements of the national team programme.

teams.heading: Uruguayan Flanker Lucas Bianchi Completes Move To Italian Club Viadana
teams.body: Uruguayan international flanker Lucas Bianchi has secured a move to Italy to join Viadana in the Serie A Elite. The 25-year-old, who represented his country at the 2023 Rugby World Cup and previously served in the leadership team at Peñarol, joins the premier Italian division as he prepares for the 2027 tournament cycle. Bianchi is among several Uruguayan players currently securing contracts across the European season, with the move officially confirmed today.

teams.heading: Scotland Women Target First Victory Against Australia In WXV Global Series
teams.body: Scotland women look to secure their first win of the WXV Global Series as they host Australia at the Edinburgh Rugby Stadium. The Scots remain winless after two difficult opening rounds against Canada and New Zealand, though they have registered 40 points in those fixtures. The visitors arrive seeking their own first tournament win following two losses. The match will be available to fans for free via the BBC Sport website, the BBC Sport app, and BBC iPlayer.

teams.heading: Wales women target back-to-back victories against USA at Cardiff Arms Park
teams.body: Following their impressive 50-19 win over South Africa, Wales women return to Cardiff Arms Park to face a USA side riding their own momentum after a comeback victory against Ireland. Head coach Sean Lynn has recalled Carys Cox to the wing and shifted Lleucu George into the fly-half role to partner Keira Bevan. teams.heading: Men sentenced for murder of former Argentina international Federico Martín Aramburú
teams.body: Legal proceedings regarding the killing of former Argentina international Federico Martín Aramburú have reached a conclusion, with men handed lengthy jail terms for his murder and attempted murder. The trial, which has drawn international attention, saw the perpetrator express remorse during the sentencing phase. Aramburú, who earned 22 caps for Los Pumas between 2004 and 2009, was killed in Paris in 2022. The case has been a poignant matter for the rugby community since the tragedy occurred.

teams.heading: Josh Canham ruled out as Lukhan Salakaia-Loto joins Wallabies starting side
teams.body: Les Kiss has been forced into a late change for Sunday’s clash against the Springboks after Josh Canham was ruled out with a mild hamstring injury. The lock pulled up sore following training on Friday, opening a starting spot for Lukhan Salakaia-Loto, with Lachlan Shaw joining the bench. Captain Harry Wilson acknowledged the setback, noting: “It is always a big loss when you lose your lineout caller and Canham has been playing some really good footy for us.”

teams.heading: Ireland women flanker Aoife Wafer ruled out of Japan Test match
teams.body: Japan faces an Ireland side reshuffled by head coach Scott Bemand for Sunday's WXV Global Series encounter in Galway. Following Ireland's 40-36 defeat to the USA last weekend, Bemand has made six changes to his starting XV, including a new-look front row and the inclusion of uncapped hooker Beth Buttimer among the replacements, as Japan looks to counter Ireland’s potent attacking threat.

teams.heading: Sarah Hirini commits to New Zealand Rugby until end of 2028
teams.body: Black Ferns Sevens veteran Sarah Hirini has extended her contract with New Zealand Rugby through to the end of 2028. The 33-year-old, who recently returned to the sport following the birth of her son, aims to compete in the Los Angeles Olympics, which would mark her fourth Games appearance. A highly decorated player, Hirini has won back-to-back Olympic gold medals and secured two World Cup titles in 15s, solidifying her status as a central figure in New Zealand’s high-performance programme.

teams.heading: Andre-Hugo Venter leads Stormers to bonus-point victory against Connacht side
teams.body: The Stormers secured a 29-15 win over Connacht in Galway on Friday, clinching a crucial bonus point in their United Rugby Championship encounter. Rookie Springboks hooker Andre-Hugo Venter claimed man-of-the-match honours for an outstanding performance that included 71 metres gained as a carrier and 17 tackles. After trailing 12-10 at half-time, the visitors capitalised on a yellow card for Connacht's Paul Boyle to regain control, with late tries from replacements Vernon Paulo and Ezekiel Ngobeni cementing the victory.
